_about: Wave 6 CC-licensed graded readers (external). We ONLY store metadata — the book itself lives on the publisher's own reader. Clicking a card opens the publisher's page in a new tab. Publishers are StoryWeaver (CC-BY), African Storybook (CC-BY), BookDash (CC-BY) and Global Digital Library. Levels loosely map Pratham/Storyweaver levels 1-5 to A1-B2. `verified` marks entries whose source URL has been inspected; others are plausible but should be re-checked on next audit. See docs/LEGAL.md for the content-rules reminders.
